people.fit_reason: Tier C: Board member and President of Pioneers-USA since 1999; key leadership figure with field experience in Indonesia before elevation to executive role.
Tier C: Board Chair at Pioneers; former Director of Development and Church Engagement at Arrive Ministries and former Pastor of Missions at Grace Church Roseville.
Tier B: Chief Administrative Officer overseeing administrative operations, member care coordination, and organizational infrastructure supporting global missionary teams.
Tier C: Board member providing governance and strategic oversight of Pioneers organization and mission operations.

orgs_discovered.evidence: Christian missions agency headquartered in Orlando, Florida, founded 1979. Operates in 97 countries with 3,077 international members serving on 345 teams among 207 people groups. Focuses on church planting among unreached people groups. Board-governed with dedicated staff for member care, finance, IT, marketing, fundraising, and recruitment.
